guidelines.detail: documentation rule GW-06 not applied (The description makes the insurance activity conditional while the package-label activity is required, and the reference has an inclusive split and join for these activities. Documented guideline GW-06 already covers inclusive gateways for activated branches, so this guideline is already stated there.)

same as LRN-007 (The label pairs show elements whose labels substitute a different decision or action for the meaning supported by the description. This is already covered by learned guideline LRN-007; no extra-element records were provided.)

documentation rule LANE-01 not applied (The description assigns work to distinct internal roles, while the reference lanes have no counterparts in the generated model. The extra pool and message flow concern the outside logistics participants, not those internal responsibilities. LANE-01 already says to use lanes to partition one process by stated roles or departments, so this guideline is already documented.)

documentation rule GW-02 not applied (The description distinguishes special shipping for large amounts from normal post shipment for small amounts, but the reference’s exclusive decision gateway has no counterpart in the generated model. GW-02 already says to use an exclusive split when exactly one data-based alternative runs.)

refines FID-01 (The description separately states that offers are made and that one provider is selected, while the generated label represents receiving an offer. This refines the general guideline to model every distinct activity stated in the description.)

refines FID-01 (The description explicitly states a preparation step for later pickup, while the reference activity and end event have no generated counterparts. This makes the general instruction to model stated activities and outcomes more actionable for final readiness steps.)

refines GW-01 (The description distinguishes the large-amount and small-amount cases, while the records show the corresponding exclusive gateway and its flows are absent. This refines GW-01 by specifying when an exclusive gateway is appropriate.)

same as LRN-041 (The description states that offers are received and that one is then selected; the generated task conflates receiving an offer with the selection. This supports the existing learned guideline LRN-041.)

refines COL-01 (The description says the secretary invites three companies to make offers and selects one. The generated model creates separate pools and message flows for the candidates, while the description does not distinguish their process roles. This refines COL-01 by clarifying how to represent interchangeable candidate participants; no learned guideline returned covers this same modeling choice.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: Use an inclusive split when one or more conditions can be true; use an inclusive join to synchronize only activated reachable branches.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that multiple activities can proceed independently, with at least one activity conditional and another required

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description distinguishes a process trigger, an activity, or an outcome from other stages of the process: Label each BPMN element according to the meaning of its corresponding described trigger, activity, or outcome; do not substitute a different stage or its purpose or result.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description distinguishes a decision, activity, or outcome from other actions or stages in the process

rules_sent_back.instruction: Use lanes to partition one process by a stated role, department, system or responsibility; lanes are not separate processes.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description assigns work in the same workflow to multiple stated roles or departments.

rules_sent_back.instruction: Use an exclusive split when exactly one data-based alternative runs. Add supported conditions and at most one default fallback.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description presents mutually exclusive alternatives selected according to a stated condition

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description distinguishes receiving proposals or offers from choosing among them: Model the choice as a separate activity rather than treating receipt of a proposal or offer as the choice.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description distinguishes receiving proposals or offers from choosing among them

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that an item is prepared for collection or transfer once the required prerequisites are ready: Model the preparation as an activity, rather than treating readiness only as a state or omitting the step; when it completes the described process outcome, represent that completion with an end event.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that an item is prepared for collection or transfer once the required prerequisites are ready

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description presents mutually exclusive alternatives selected according to a stated condition: model an exclusive gateway to route the process into the applicable alternative, with outgoing flows reflecting the stated conditions
rules_sent_back.situation: the description presents mutually exclusive alternatives selected according to a stated condition

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description identifies multiple external organizations as interchangeable candidates for the same interaction and says that one is selected: Model the candidates collectively as one external participant, rather than creating a separate pool and message flow for each candidate.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description identifies multiple external organizations as interchangeable candidates for the same interaction and says that one is selected
